summary: OpenAI previewed Private Safety Processing, a system that detects misuse patterns across related interactions while remaining compatible with Zero Data Retention and customer-controlled encryption, with rollout and a technical white paper planned for September.

practices.reason: Describes a safety-monitoring method for detecting cross-interaction misuse, but it is OpenAI's own internal process running on OpenAI infrastructure and not a technique an external engineering team could replicate.
practices.quote: Private Safety Processing extends those protections across related interactions, allowing automated systems to identify patterns without OpenAI personnel having access to retained customer content.

practices.reason: Enterprise customers on ZDR or encrypted-storage deployments will need to track how safety signals and enforcement actions are surfaced once this rolls out, but it is still a preview with details forthcoming in September.
practices.quote: We plan to start rolling out Private Safety Processing, and share a technical white paper, in September.
